components.gap: Ultraproducts are not registered at their declared source scope. The only registry row for the ultraproduct glyph \prod_{i\in I}\mathcal M_i/\mathcal U (handbook/registry/symbols.csv:47, printed at handbook/generated/symbols-tables.tex:1504) records the scope 'Legacy pre-batch5 P3.3 reader meaning', whose binding (handbook/registry/symbol-scopes.json:8738) is the single region ch:qe-categoricity. The source declares the ultraproduct in ch:types-ultraproducts: Definition [Ultraproduct] in sec:types-ultraproducts-05 (handbook/restoration/inherited-06942-07134.tex:19-35), used in thm:los (78-94) and in ex:types-ultraproducts-04 (handbook/restoration/inherited-07135-07149.tex:1-7). That declaration, those uses, the subtable's own ultraproduct row (handbook/parts/p03/maps-elementarity-supplement.tex:44-48, tab:p03-model-symbols) and the annex use (handbook/annex/p03/types-ultraproducts-supplement.tex:30) all lie outside the registered region (the project's reader index places ch:qe-categoricity at reader positions 6946-7077, sec:types-ultraproducts-05 at 6754 and tab:p03-model-symbols at 6813), and the registered region contains no use of the glyph (its recorded first_use sec:qe-categoricity-01 has none). The ultrapower \mathcal M^I/\mathcal U, declared in the same definition (inherited-06942-07134.tex:33-34) and used in cor:diagonal-ultrapower (166-171), has no registry row, so a glyph/role of the ultraproduct family is omitted. Owed: register the ultraproduct glyph, and the ultrapower glyph declared with it, at the scope where the source declares them, a region of ch:types-ultraproducts beginning at sec:types-ultraproducts-05 that contains every routed use (including tab:p03-model-symbols and the Part 3 annex use), so that no routed use of either glyph lies outside an in-scope registry row.
